messages.subject: Re: error: 'names' attribute [16] must be the same length as the vector [9]
parts:
the syntax of the LGCM is:

library(lavaan)
install.packages("simsem")
popModel <- '
   i =~ 1*t1 + 1*t2 + 1*t3 + 1*t4
   s =~ 0*t1 + 1*t2 + 2*t3 + 3*t4
   i ~ 0 
   s ~ 0
   i ~~ 1*i  
   s ~~ 0.2*s     
   i ~~ 0*s    
   t1 ~~ 1*t1
   t2 ~~ 1.2*t2
   t3 ~~ 1.8*t3
   t4 ~~ 2.8*t4
'
SModel <-'intercept =~ 1*t1 + 1*t2 + 1*t3 + 1*t4
          slope     =~ 0*t1 + 1*t2 + 2*t3 + 3*t4'
library(simsem)
Output1 <- sim(1000, model=SModel, n=50, generate=popModel, std.lv=TRUE, lavaanfun="growth", seed=53487)
summary(Output1)


thanks for your help.

parts: I need to simulate growth models and I thank you immensely if you can solve it as soon as possible

Actually, I think this bug was already fixed a while ago.  Please install the latest development version of simsem.  Assuming you already have the development version of lavaan installed:

install.packages("lavaan", repos="http://www.da.ugent.be", type="source")

and the devtools package is already installed: 

install.packages("devtools")

This syntax will install simsem:

devtools::install_github("simsem/simsem/simsem")

To be safe, restart R after installing, then run library(simsem).  I just ran your example without any problem.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
UvA web page: http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
